messages:
Jen Li: T-minus 45m to the change window. Quick sweep — any hotfix exemptions or late blockers? If none, we freeze pins at T-15.
Aaron: No hotfixes from infra. Canary warming on dedicated-pool-3.
Maya: Heads up — small release-notes add (summary of env changes). Not a blocker.
Ops Oncall: Observability green. I’ll run an extra smoke run at T-20 and keep an eye on 500s.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Starting canary rollout for service=api version=v3.14.2 -> dedicated-pool-3. Canary 1/5 (5% traffic). Logs: https://logs.internal/r/abc123
Jen Li: @Ops Oncall please run quick smoke: /scripts/smoke.sh --quick and paste summary here.
Ops Oncall: running now — output: 3 checks, all PASS. Latency median 78ms. :thumbsup:
Aaron: Requesting a one-off hotfix exemption for a tiny tokenization config tweak (no model change). Will only touch container env and do rolling restart. Marking as #hf-exempt if approved.
Maya: Reviewed docs diff, LGTM. No conflicts spotted.
Jen Li: What's the rollback risk? Aaron, put a short rollback plan here.
Aaron: Rollback plan: revert pin (deployctl unpin --service api --version v3.14.1) then force canary to v3.14.1. Expected brownout window <2m. Monitor queue drain.
Jen Li: OK. Approving hotfix exemption for token-config. @deploy-bot apply pin and tag exemption. Use pin name v3.14.2-hf-a1 and freeze window +2h default. Command: deployctl pin --service api --version v3.14.2-hf-a1 --tag hf-exempt
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Pin applied: service=api pin=v3.14.2-hf-a1 tag=hf-exempt. Freeze engaged until 2h from now. Auto-rollback trigger: error rate >5% OR latency degradation threshold exceeded.
Ops Oncall: Smoke still green after deploy. Keeping watch. I’ll escalate if p50 >120ms sustained for 2m.
Paul: Small note — added a callout in release notes about the env var change (breaking for self-hosted). Not blocking the freeze.
Jen Li: Last call for other exemptions? Silence until T-10. Eng teams: do not merge to main. Locking pins at T-10.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Freeze lock established on branch=main for service=api. Unpin requires explicit approval from Jen Li or Ops Oncall.
Aaron: Ack.
Jen Li: Moving to launch cadence. Good luck everyone :rocket:
